mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM I_PropertyChange WHERE Pc_Code = #{pcCode} AND Pc_Flag = '3' AND Pc_Date = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120))
SELECT TOP 1 Pl_Flag FROM I_PropertyLook WHERE CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120)) BETWEEN Pl_fDt AND Pl_lDt AND Pl_Flag IN ('1', '2') ORDER BY Pl_fDt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO I_PropertyChange ( Pc_Code, Pc_Seq, Pc_Date, Pc_Flag, Pc_JumFg, Pc_Area1, Pc_Remark, Pc_UserID, Pc_RegDate ) SELECT #{pcCode}, ISNULL(MAX(Pc_Seq), 0) + 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120)), '3', #{pcJumFg}, #{pcArea1}, CASE WHEN #{pcJumFg} = '1' THEN 'QR 정기 재고조사' WHEN #{pcJumFg} = '2' THEN 'QR 수시 재고조사' ELSE 'QR 재고조사' END, #{pcUserID}, GETDATE() FROM I_PropertyChange WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE Pc_Code = #{pcCode}
